text_56a8f681287c: Enable Polish railway network in route knowledge or the STK editor. The switch is independent of language. Poland opens the country overview. Android includes the overview, detail tiles and operating points offline. The browser loads only the required files. The reference comes from OpenStreetMap/Geofabrik and may include sidings and industrial lines. It is not an official PKP PLK operating map. Enabling it does not create knowledge. The Polish STK editor lets you search stations, draw through operating points and save explicitly. PL identifiers are OSM references, not German DS100 or VzG numbers.
